title: Quillwork operations
description: Every op of the catalogue (DESIGN §6.2, §8.3), the transaction envelope, read requests and results. Errors: error.schema.json. The agent-facing tools in spec/tools map onto these.

Guards.description: Common guard fields every mutating op accepts. base_version and mode default to the transaction's.

Transaction.description: apply([op...]): atomic. On any error nothing changes. One committed transaction = one version = one change set.

mode.description: Default for every op; track unless set.

label.description: Change-set label shown on the review card.

author.description: Revision author; defaults to the engine's configured agent author.

turn.description: Host chat-turn id the change set links to.

projection_mode.description: Mode of the changed lines in the result; default accepted.

OpResult.description: Result of a committed transaction: a diff, never the document (DESIGN §6.1).

change_set.description: Null when nothing tracked was written (direct mode, accept/reject).

changed.description: Projection lines of every block whose line changed, renumbered list items included, in document order.

removed.description: Anchors that no longer exist (direct deletes, accepted deletions, rejected insertions).

outline.description: The new outline line when headings changed, else null.

text.description: Projection text (outline, read, find, lint, help).

next.description: Open range of the next window when read stopped at its budget.

Op_replace_text.description: Word-level diff of the old and new text; surviving tokens keep their runs, inserted words take the left neighbour's rPr (DESIGN §7.2).

find.description: Exact text inside the block (accepted mode). Absent = the whole block.

occurrence.description: 1-based; needed when find occurs more than once, else AMBIGUOUS.

replace.description: May be empty (a pure deletion). Inline marks of spec/projection.md are allowed.

Op_find_and_replace.description: Replace every occurrence of find (accepted-mode text of the body, or of one block or range) with the same word-level diff as replace_text. count is the number of occurrences the agent expects: any other number is INVALID_OP at /count, naming the blocks it does occur in, so nothing changes by surprise.

anchor.description: Limit the search to this block or range. Absent = the main body (table cells included).

Op_insert_paragraph.description: New paragraph(s) cloning the anchor's pPr; each newline in text starts another paragraph.

style.description: "inherit" (default: clone the anchor's pPr), a projection KIND (P, H1-H9, LI) or a style id or name.

list.description: Default continue when the anchor is a list item.

Op_delete_block.description: Tracked delete of a paragraph, table or drawing-only paragraph, paragraph mark included (DESIGN §6.2).

Op_move_block.description: v1: tracked delete + tracked insert. The moved block keeps its anchor.

Op_split_paragraph.description: Insert a paragraph mark right before at_text; the new second paragraph gets a new anchor.

occurrence.description: 1-based; needed when find occurs more than once, else AMBIGUOUS.

Op_merge_paragraphs.description: Delete first's paragraph mark so second joins it; second must directly follow first.

Op_set_text_format.description: Tracked run formatting (w:rPrChange with the old rPr). null clears direct formatting for that mark.

find.description: Exact text inside the block (accepted mode). Absent = the whole block.

occurrence.description: 1-based; needed when find occurs more than once, else AMBIGUOUS.

underline.description: true = single, or an underline style.

Op_set_paragraph.description: Tracked paragraph properties (w:pPrChange). Lengths in twips.

style.description: "inherit" (default: clone the anchor's pPr), a projection KIND (P, H1-H9, LI) or a style id or name.

Op_insert_break.description: Page or column break after a block, or a section break (copies the current sectPr; sectPrChange where trackable).

section_type.description: Only for kind section; default next.

Op_insert_footnote.description: Footnote (or endnote) reference in a tracked run right after find; the note becomes story fn<n> / en<n>.

occurrence.description: 1-based; needed when find occurs more than once, else AMBIGUOUS.

Op_set_hyperlink.description: Wrap find in a w:hyperlink (new external rel), point it at a bookmark, or remove the link.

occurrence.description: 1-based; needed when find occurs more than once, else AMBIGUOUS.

Op_insert_field.description: Complex field after find (or at the block end). The cached result is computed where possible.

find.description: Exact text inside the block (accepted mode). Absent = the whole block.

occurrence.description: 1-based; needed when find occurs more than once, else AMBIGUOUS.

args.description: Instruction arguments and switches, e.g. "_Ref123 \\h" for REF or "\\@ \"d MMMM yyyy\"" for DATE.

Op_set_list.description: Reuses a w:num with the same look (abstractNum signature) before minting one; never edits a shared abstractNum.

list.description: bullet, numbered, none or continue:<anchor of a list item>.

Op_restart_numbering.description: New w:num with lvlOverride/startOverride from this item on.

Op_change_level.description: w:ilvl via pPrChange. Give delta or level.

Op_insert_table.description: Inherits the document's most-used table style; width = text width; tracked per row.

style.description: "inherit" (default: clone the anchor's pPr), a projection KIND (P, H1-H9, LI) or a style id or name.

data.description: Cell texts per row; shorter rows are padded with empty cells.

Op_insert_row.description: Tracked row insert (w:trPr/w:ins); clones the reference row's trPr/tcPr.

Op_set_cell.description: Replaces a cell's text; delegates to replace_text / insert_paragraph inside the cell.

confirm.description: Required in track mode: Word's support for tracked cell insertion is uneven (CONFIRM_REQUIRED).
Required in track mode: Word's support for tracked cell insertion is uneven (CONFIRM_REQUIRED).

Op_merge_cells.description: Not trackable in Word: direct mode only (UNSUPPORTED reason direct_only otherwise).

Op_split_cell.description: Not trackable in Word: direct mode only.

Op_insert_image.description: Inline picture from an asset the host already holds; deduped by hash; clamped to the text width. Alt text is required unless decorative.

find.description: Exact text inside the block (accepted mode). Absent = the whole block.

occurrence.description: 1-based; needed when find occurs more than once, else AMBIGUOUS.

Op_replace_image.description: Swap the picture; tracked as delete + insert of the drawing run.

Op_resize_image.description: Keeps aspect; wp:extent and a:ext together. Untracked in Word: recorded in the change set sidecar.

Op_set_alt_text.description: wp:docPr descr/title; untracked (Word does not track it).

Op_delete_image.description: Tracked: the drawing run in w:del.

Op_add_comment.description: Range + reference + all four comment parts and people.xml (DESIGN §6.2).

find.description: Exact text inside the block (accepted mode). Absent = the whole block.

occurrence.description: 1-based; needed when find occurs more than once, else AMBIGUOUS.

Op_edit_comment.description: Replace a comment's body; author, date and threading are kept.

Op_delete_comment.description: Range, reference and all four part entries; replies go with it.

Op_accept.description: Structural accept per revision type (DESIGN §7.4). Always applied directly.

change_set.description: The engine resolves the change set to its revision ids from the session log before applying; an unknown id is NOT_FOUND (what: change_set).

Op_reject.description: Structural reject per revision type (DESIGN §7.4). Always applied directly.

change_set.description: The engine resolves the change set to its revision ids from the session log before applying; an unknown id is NOT_FOUND (what: change_set).

Op_compare.description: Produce the change set that turns this version into other (DESIGN §11.3), authored as author.

other.description: Host reference to the other .docx (an upload id).

Op_fill.description: Fill {placeholder} tokens and content controls (by tag or alias, data-bound ones too).

Op_read.description: Projection of a selection; no selection = header, outline and first window.

Op_find.description: Matching blocks as projection lines, in document order.

Op_get_block.description: Full formatting detail of one block, as a view-model block in data.

Op_list_images.description: Every drawing with anchor, asset, size and alt text.

Op_get_image.description: The image bytes (base64 in data) so a vision model can look at it.

Op_list_fields.description: Placeholders and content controls with type and allowed values.

Op_help.description: One-line signatures of every op, or of one.
